subtopics.label: NIH Funding, Grants, and Physician-Scientist Career Development
subtopics.description: Research examining NIH funding mechanisms, grant success rates, funding gaps, and career development programs (K-awards, K99/R00, R38) for physician-scientists, surgeon-scientists, and trainees in academic biomedical research.
subtopics.short_description: Grant mechanisms, funding success rates, and career development awards for physician-scientists and biomedical trainees.

subtopics.label: Scholarly Activity and Research Training in Residency and Fellowship Programs
subtopics.description: Studies assessing the quantity, quality, and barriers to scholarly activity and research training during medical residency and fellowship programs across pediatrics, surgery, and other specialties.
subtopics.short_description: Quantity, quality, and barriers to research training across medical residency and fellowship programs.

subtopics.label: Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion in Academic Medicine and Research Workforce
subtopics.description: Investigations into representation, promotion, retention, and systemic barriers for underrepresented minorities, women, and other marginalized groups in academic medicine, surgery, and biomedical research.
subtopics.display_name: Diversity, Equity & Inclusion in Academic Medicine
subtopics.short_description: Representation, promotion, and systemic barriers for underrepresented groups in academic medicine and biomedical research.

subtopics.label: Clinical Trial Design, Conduct, Quality, and Premature Termination
subtopics.description: Analyses of the characteristics, methodological quality, reporting standards, and factors leading to premature termination of randomized controlled trials across surgical and medical specialties.
subtopics.short_description: Characteristics, reporting standards, and factors driving premature termination of randomized controlled trials.

subtopics.label: Peer Review, Scientific Publishing, and Research Integrity
subtopics.description: Studies examining the peer review process, publication practices, article retractions, research misconduct, conflicts of interest, and integrity frameworks in biomedical literature.
subtopics.short_description: Publication practices, article retractions, research misconduct, and integrity frameworks in biomedical literature.

subtopics.label: Electronic Health Records, Data Warehouses, and Clinical Research Informatics Infrastructure
subtopics.description: Research on enterprise data warehouses, EHR-based data extraction, common data models, and informatics infrastructure supporting clinical and translational research at academic medical centers.
subtopics.short_description: Enterprise data warehouses, EHR-based extraction, and informatics platforms supporting clinical and translational research.

subtopics.label: Biobanking, Biospecimen Collection, and Repository Management
subtopics.description: Studies addressing the establishment, standardization, ethical governance, and operational management of biobanks and biospecimen repositories, including space biobanking and pandemic-era adaptations.
subtopics.short_description: Establishment, standardization, ethical governance, and operations of biobanks and biospecimen repositories.

subtopics.label: Race, Ethnicity Data Quality, and Representation in Research Databases
subtopics.description: Investigations into the accuracy, completeness, and standardization of race and ethnicity data in EHRs, clinical registries, and research publications, and their implications for health equity research.
subtopics.display_name: Race & Ethnicity Data Quality in Registries
subtopics.short_description: Accuracy and standardization of race and ethnicity data in EHRs, registries, and publications for health equity research.

subtopics.label: Systematic Reviews, Evidence Synthesis Methods, and Literature Search Quality
subtopics.description: Research on the methodology, quality assessment, search strategies, and infrastructure supporting systematic reviews, meta-analyses, and evidence synthesis in biomedical research.
subtopics.short_description: Methodology, search quality, and infrastructure supporting systematic reviews and meta-analyses in biomedical research.

subtopics.label: Clinical Registries, Coordinated Registry Networks, and Real-World Evidence
subtopics.description: Studies developing and evaluating coordinated registry networks, data linkage algorithms, and real-world evidence frameworks for medical devices and clinical outcomes research.
subtopics.short_description: Coordinated registry networks, data linkage algorithms, and real-world evidence frameworks for clinical outcomes research.

subtopics.label: Omics Technologies, Sequencing Platforms, and Benchmarking Standards
subtopics.description: Studies benchmarking and standardizing next-generation sequencing, epigenomics, metabolomics, and other omics platforms to ensure reproducibility and data quality in biomedical research.
subtopics.short_description: Standardization and benchmarking of next-generation sequencing, epigenomics, and metabolomics for reproducible biomedical data.

subtopics.label: Artificial Intelligence, NLP, and Machine Learning in Biomedical Research Infrastructure
subtopics.description: Research developing and evaluating AI, natural language processing, and machine learning tools for biomedical data extraction, image analysis, literature mining, and clinical research support.
subtopics.display_name: AI & NLP for Biomedical Data Infrastructure
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning and natural language processing tools for biomedical data extraction, image analysis, and literature mining.

subtopics.label: Institutional Repositories, Research Data Management, and Knowledge Dissemination
subtopics.description: Studies on institutional repositories, research data systems, authorship tracking tools, library services, and computable biomedical knowledge frameworks that support research dissemination and discovery.
subtopics.short_description: Research data systems, authorship tracking, and computable knowledge frameworks supporting discovery and dissemination.

subtopics.label: Clinical Trial Recruitment, Participant Engagement, and Research Participation
subtopics.description: Research on strategies, barriers, and facilitators for recruiting diverse participants into clinical trials and research studies, including older adults, minority populations, and caregivers.
subtopics.short_description: Strategies and barriers for enrolling diverse populations, including older adults and minorities, into clinical research.

subtopics.label: Global Health Research Capacity Building and International Collaboration
subtopics.description: Studies examining infrastructure development, training programs, and collaborative frameworks to build research capacity in low-resource settings and among underrepresented global health researchers.
subtopics.short_description: Infrastructure development and training programs to strengthen research capacity in low-resource and underrepresented settings.

subtopics.label: Laboratory Methods, Cell Line Generation, and Biological Sample Preparation
subtopics.description: Research focused on protocols and techniques for preparing biological samples, generating cell lines, and isolating biological materials including DNA, extracellular vesicles, and skeletal cells for downstream analysis.
subtopics.short_description: Protocols for preparing biological samples, generating cell lines, and isolating DNA and extracellular materials for downstream analysis.

subtopics.label: Genomic Databases, Bioinformatics Atlases, and Computational Biology Resources
subtopics.description: Development and characterization of genomic and transcriptomic databases, atlases, and bioinformatics tools including cancer driver databases, transcriptome atlases, transposon sequencing databases, and protein interaction resources.
subtopics.short_description: Cancer driver databases, transcriptome atlases, and computational biology tools supporting genomic and translational research.

subtopics.label: Medical Imaging Data Standards, Formats, and Reproducibility Frameworks
subtopics.description: Research establishing standardized data formats, acquisition protocols, and reproducibility frameworks for medical and biological imaging modalities including MRI, MRS, AFM, and neuroimaging classification models.
subtopics.short_description: Standardized formats, acquisition protocols, and reproducibility frameworks for MRI, neuroimaging, and biological imaging modalities.

subtopics.label: Fellowship and Residency Program Director Demographics and Leadership Characteristics
subtopics.description: Descriptive analyses of the demographic composition, qualifications, and leadership characteristics of program directors across medical specialties including radiology, ophthalmology, and interventional radiology.
subtopics.short_description: Demographic composition and qualifications of residency and fellowship program directors across medical specialties.

subtopics.label: Academic Medicine Compensation, Staffing Shortages, and Workforce Equity
subtopics.description: Studies examining compensation models, salary transparency, staffing shortages, and workforce equity issues across academic medical specialties including radiology, emergency medicine, and otolaryngology.
subtopics.short_description: Salary transparency, staffing shortages, and workforce equity across academic medical specialties.

subtopics.label: Preclinical Tumor Models and Experimental Platforms for Drug Discovery
subtopics.description: Development and application of in vivo and ex vivo tumor models, patient-derived xenografts, and automated experimental platforms for cancer drug discovery and neuroscience research.
subtopics.display_name: Preclinical Tumor Models & Drug Discovery Platforms
subtopics.short_description: Patient-derived xenografts and automated experimental platforms for cancer drug discovery and neuroscience research.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Clinical Practice Adaptation, Treatment Guidelines, and Epidemiological Data
subtopics.description: Research documenting institutional and national responses to COVID-19 including clinical practice adaptations, treatment guideline development, and epidemiological data resources.
subtopics.short_description: Institutional and national responses to COVID-19, including practice adaptations, treatment guidelines, and epidemiological resources.

subtopics.label: Specialty Society Awards, Recognition, and Gender Equity in Academic Medicine
subtopics.description: Analyses of recognition awards and honors within medical specialty societies, with a focus on identifying gender and demographic disparities in award recipients.
subtopics.short_description: Demographic disparities in recognition awards and honors across medical specialty societies.

subtopics.label: Clinical Trial Outcomes Extraction, NLP Datasets, and Evidence Annotation
subtopics.description: Development of annotated datasets and NLP benchmarks for extracting clinically meaningful outcomes from trial publications, supporting automated evidence synthesis.
subtopics.short_description: Annotated datasets and NLP benchmarks for extracting clinically meaningful outcomes from trial publications.

subtopics.label: Genetic Variant Classification, Reclassification, and Genetic Counselor Training
subtopics.description: Studies addressing the evidence quality behind genetic variant classification and reclassification, and the training needs of genetic counselors in emerging subspecialties.
subtopics.short_description: Evidence quality behind variant reclassification and training needs of genetic counselors in emerging subspecialties.
